options.text: The emission of gamma radiation from a nucleus
The absorption of neutrons by a nucleus
The joining of two small nuclei to form a larger nucleus, releasing energy
The splitting of a large nucleus into two smaller nuclei

questions.explanation: Nuclear fusion is the process in which two small, light nuclei join together to form a larger nucleus, releasing a large amount of energy in the process. It is the process that powers stars, including our Sun, where hydrogen nuclei fuse to form helium.
